data.Description: Execution of the Drogon DG2 FMU workflow: 250 realisations, ERT one-by-one design, RMS 13.1 geomodel, OPM Flow 2023.04 reservoir simulation. Case: drogon_design. Run date: 2026-02-15.

data.Name: Porosity and Cementation Uncertainty
data.Description: Risk of lower-than-expected porosity due to carbonate cementation in the Valysar Fm. Diagenetic overprint may reduce effective pore space by 3-8 p.u. in the Central Horst and East Lowland segments.

MitigationActions: Calibrated porosity model with NMR logs

data.Name: Oil-Water Contact Position
data.Description: Uncertainty in OWC depth across Drogon segments due to limited well penetrations. Only 3 wells with pressure data, OWC varies by ±15m between segments.

MitigationActions: Included OWC as sensitivity parameter in FMU

data.Name: Fault Seal and Compartmentalization
data.Description: Risk that faults between segments are sealing, reducing connected volumes and recovery. Cross-fault juxtaposition analysis suggests potential barriers in CentralRamp-NorthHorst boundary.

data.Name: Relative Permeability Uncertainty
data.Description: Limited SCAL data — only 4 core plugs from one segment. Relperm curves may not represent all facies, particularly channel vs. crevasse in Valysar zone.

MitigationActions: Varied relperm endpoints in FMU sensitivity

data.Name: Aquifer Support Strength
data.Description: Uncertainty in aquifer size and connectivity. Strong aquifer support would improve sweep but may cause early water breakthrough in Volon zone producers.

MitigationActions: Aquifer multiplier included in sensitivity design

data.Name: Subsea Template Delivery Delay
data.Description: Supply chain risk for subsea template fabrication. Lead time 24-30 months, sole-source vendor. Delay would postpone first oil by 6-12 months.
